specs.name: turbo_power
specs.source_sentence: The 2026 Tata Punch facelift's new 1.2-litre three-cylinder turbo-petrol engine makes 118 bhp at 5,500 rpm and 170 Nm from 1,750 to 4,000 rpm.

specs.name: turbo_torque
specs.source_sentence: The new 1.2-litre turbo-petrol produces 170 Nm of torque, offered only with a 6-speed manual gearbox.

specs.name: engine
specs.source_sentence: The 2026 Punch facelift adds a 1.2-litre turbocharged petrol engine with a 6-speed manual, alongside the carryover 1.2 Revotron naturally aspirated petrol and CNG options.

specs.name: safety_rating
specs.source_sentence: The Tata Punch scored 5 stars for adult occupant protection and 4 stars for child occupant protection in Global NCAP crash tests.

specs.name: mileage
specs.source_sentence: The Tata Punch petrol returns a claimed fuel efficiency of 18.8 to 20.09 kmpl.

specs.name: boot_space
specs.source_sentence: The Tata Punch offers a boot space of 366 litres.

specs.name: ground_clearance
specs.source_sentence: The Tata Punch has a ground clearance of about 187 mm.

specs.name: length
specs.source_sentence: The Tata Punch is a sub-4-metre micro-SUV, around 3,857 mm long, 1,742 mm wide and 1,615 mm tall.

specs.name: wheelbase
specs.source_sentence: The Tata Punch has a wheelbase of 2,445 mm.

specs.name: body_type
specs.source_sentence: The Tata Punch is a sub-4-metre, 5-door micro-SUV in the A-segment.
